title: From '50 Worst Inventions' to $4.1 Billion
description:
Time magazine called Crocs one of the 50 worst inventions.

Sources:
- Wikipedia: Crocs: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Crocs

From Wikipedia (Crocs): founded in 2002; its first model, the Beach, was unveiled at the Fort Lauderdale Boat Show in 2002 and all 200 pairs sold out; during the 2008 financial crisis the stock dropped as low as $0.79 before rebounding; Time magazine listed Crocs among the world's "50 Worst Inventions" in 2010; Crocs had sold 300 million pairs by 2017; revenue was US$4.102 billion in 2024. Not financial advice.

#shorts #crocs #shoes #business #howtheymakemoney

scenes.narration: Time magazine called Crocs one of the 50 worst inventions.
Yet the company now sells about 4.1 billion dollars a year.
It began at a boat show. All 200 pairs sold out.
Then a crash hit. The stock fell under a dollar.
But people kept buying. 300 million pairs.
